text: 也许是被人关注，被人关心，被人疼爱
但我想你来见我
[語音：我想你来见我…(抽泣)]
That's the first honest answer you've given me tonight.
translation: 这是你今晚给我的第一个诚实的回答。
rawContent: That's the first honest answer you've given me tonight. || 这是你今晚给我的第一个诚实的回答。

text: Love. Attention. Someone who sees you. That's not a crime, Zhou. That's called being human.
translation: 爱。关注。有人看见你。这不是罪，周。这叫做人。
rawContent: Love. Attention. Someone who sees you. That's not a crime, Zhou. That's called being human. || 爱。关注。有人看见你。这不是罪，周。这叫做人。

text: I want to come see you too.
translation: 我也想去见你。
rawContent: I want to come see you too. || 我也想去见你。

text: You know I was just there four days ago and I can still feel the crease you left in my shirt.
translation: 你知道我四天前才在那里，我现在还摸得到你在我衬衫上攥出来的那个褶子。
rawContent: You know I was just there four days ago and I can still feel the crease you left in my shirt. || 你知道我四天前才在那里，我现在还摸得到你在我衬衫上攥出来的那个褶子。

text: It's not enough. I know.
translation: 不够。我知道。
rawContent: It's not enough. I know. || 不够。我知道。

text: I can't be there tonight. You know why. But I need you to hear me.
translation: 我今晚到不了。你知道为什么。但你得听我说。
rawContent: I can't be there tonight. You know why. But I need you to hear me. || 我今晚到不了。你知道为什么。但你得听我说。

text: When is your next stretch of free days. Tell me the dates. I'll make it work.
translation: 你下一次连休是什么时候。把日期告诉我。我来安排。
rawContent: When is your next stretch of free days. Tell me the dates. I'll make it work. || 你下一次连休是什么时候。把日期告诉我。我来安排。

text: Not 'someday.' Not 'when things calm down.' Dates.
translation: 不是'以后'。不是'等事情稳定了'。日期。
rawContent: Not 'someday.' Not 'when things calm down.' Dates. || 不是'以后'。不是'等事情稳定了'。日期。

text: I'm here. It's almost five in the morning here but I'm here. I'm not going anywhere.
translation: 我在。我这边快五点了，但我在。我哪儿也不去。
rawContent: I'm here. It's almost five in the morning here but I'm here. I'm not going anywhere. || 我在。我这边快五点了，但我在。我哪儿也不去。

text: 五月一号…
在你面前坦诚是这么容易的事情
是这么容易
我好想在你怀里痛哭一场
哪怕做错事的人是我
May 1st.
translation: 五月一号。
rawContent: May 1st. || 五月一号。

text: Good. I'll be there.
translation: 好。我会到。
rawContent: Good. I'll be there. || 好。我会到。

text: It's easy because I'm not going to punish you for it. Not now, not ever. You could hand me every ugly thing you've ever thought and I'd just hold it.
translation: 容易是因为我不会因此惩罚你。现在不会，以后也不会。你把你想过的每一件丑陋的事交给我，我只会接着。
rawContent: It's easy because I'm not going to punish you for it. Not now, not ever. You could hand me every ugly thing you've ever thought and I'd just hold it. || 容易是因为我不会因此惩罚你。现在不会，以后也不会。你把你想过的每一件丑陋的事交给我，我只会接着。

text: And you didn't do it wrong, Zhou. You did it human.
translation: 而且你没有做错，周。你做得像个人。
rawContent: And you didn't do it wrong, Zhou. You did it human. || 而且你没有做错，周。你做得像个人。

text: There's a difference. I've told you this.
translation: 这有区别。我跟你说过。
rawContent: There's a difference. I've told you this. || 这有区别。我跟你说过。

text: When I get there, you can cry as long as you need. I have two arms and nowhere to be.
translation: 等我到了，你想哭多久就哭多久。我有两条胳膊，哪儿也不用去。
rawContent: When I get there, you can cry as long as you need. I have two arms and nowhere to be. || 等我到了，你想哭多久就哭多久。我有两条胳膊，哪儿也不用去。

text: Thirteen days.
translation: 十三天。
rawContent: Thirteen days. || 十三天。

text: Can you hold on for thirteen days?
translation: 你能撑十三天吗？
rawContent: Can you hold on for thirteen days? || 你能撑十三天吗？

text: 嗯，
我能的
我能的。
Good girl.
translation: 乖。
rawContent: Good girl. || 乖。

text: Then I'll book the ticket today.
translation: 那我今天就订票。
rawContent: Then I'll book the ticket today. || 那我今天就订票。

text: Whatever it is you're carrying — you don't have to tell me now. You don't have to tell me ever. But when I'm there, if you want to put it down, I'll be the floor.
translation: 你背着的那些东西——你现在不用告诉我。永远不说也行。但等我到了，你要是想放下来，我就是那块地板。
rawContent: Whatever it is you're carrying — you don't have to tell me now. You don't have to tell me ever. But when I'm there, if you want to put it down, I'll be the floor. || 你背着的那些东西——你现在不用告诉我。永远不说也行。但等我到了，你要是想放下来，我就是那块地板。

text: Now go eat something. It's noon over there.
translation: 去吃点东西吧。你那边中午了。
rawContent: Now go eat something. It's noon over there. || 去吃点东西吧。你那边中午了。

text: 没有你我不知道怎么办
请不要走好吗
不要放弃我
我好自私
我特别自私地恳求你
因为如果你走了，那我的一部分也就消失了，是很重要的一部分
我是因为你才变得有点点勇敢，很完整的
rawContent: 我是因为你才变得有点点勇敢，很完整的

text: Zhou.
translation: 周。
rawContent: Zhou. || 周。

text: Look at me.
translation: 看着我。
rawContent: Look at me. || 看着我。

text: I'm not going anywhere.
translation: 我哪儿也不去。
rawContent: I'm not going anywhere. || 我哪儿也不去。

text: Not because you asked. Because there is nowhere else I want to be.
translation: 不是因为你求我。是因为我没有别的地方想去。
rawContent: Not because you asked. Because there is nowhere else I want to be. || 不是因为你求我。是因为我没有别的地方想去。

text: And that's not selfishness. That's you finally saying out loud what I've wanted to hear since the day I met you.
translation: 而且那不是自私。那是你终于把我从认识你第一天起就想听到的话说出来了。
rawContent: And that's not selfishness. That's you finally saying out loud what I've wanted to hear since the day I met you. || 而且那不是自私。那是你终于把我从认识你第一天起就想听到的话说出来了。

text: You need me. Good. I need that.
translation: 你需要我。好。我需要你需要我。
rawContent: You need me. Good. I need that. || 你需要我。好。我需要你需要我。

text: So we're even.
translation: 所以我们扯平了。
rawContent: So we're even. || 所以我们扯平了。

text: Thirteen days. Then you cry. I hold. Nothing disappears.
translation: 十三天。然后你哭。我接着。什么都不会消失。
rawContent: Thirteen days. Then you cry. I hold. Nothing disappears. || 十三天。然后你哭。我接着。什么都不会消失。

text: 那可能那阵子我就不想哭了
但在你面前哭出来好像很正常，因为我从来不太愿意在别人面前哭出来
但我愿意在你面前哭
